connector.name: ALEETH Authority MCP
connector.registryDescription: The first MCP governed by ICA. Every action is gated and sealed with a verifiable receipt.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.aleeth.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.aleeth, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: OAuth 2.0 bearer token. Discover the authorization server via RFC 9728 metadata at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource. Read-only credentials available on request.
